name: MCP-RADAR
description: MCP-RADAR is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' tool use capabilities within the Model Context Protocol (MCP) framework. It includes 507 tasks across six domains such as mathematical reasoning, web search, and file management, measuring answer correctness and operational accuracy with objective, quantifiable metrics.
reputation: Widespread industry adoption of MCP framework; first benchmark specifically for MCP tool use evaluation
notes: Uses both authentic MCP tools and high-fidelity simulations; evaluates computational resource efficiency and tool-invocation rounds
